## Function Parse Command

argv into one Command or a usage error; global --root and --pretty anywhere.

Behaviour: parseCommand(argv) scans argv left to right. A token starting with "--" is a flag: --pretty and --judge take no value; --root, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches, --slice-cap-bytes, --spec, --component, --map, --out, --checks take the next token whatever it is; any other flag (also --x=y) → "unknown flag: <t>"; a value flag as the last token → "flag <t> needs a value"; a flag seen twice → "flag <t> given twice", except --component, which repeats and keeps every value in argv order (the first such error in argv order wins). Every other token is a word. Then the command from the words: none → "no command (commands: deck check, plan, run)"; "run" → run; "plan" → plan; "deck" "check" → deck check; a first word scout, primer, review or report → NotYetError "command <word> is not available yet"; "deck" followed by add, status, reset or clear → NotYetError "command deck <w> is not available yet"; anything else → "unknown command: <words joined by a space>". More words than the command takes → "unexpected argument: <first extra>". Then, in this order: a flag the command does not take → "flag <f> does not apply to <command>" (deck check takes --root, --pretty, --deck, --slice-cap-bytes; run takes --root, --pretty, --deck, --processor, --run-id, --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches; plan takes --root, --pretty, --spec, --component, --map, --judge, --out, --checks), in argv order; plan without --spec → "missing --spec", else plan is done: {name: "plan", root, pretty, spec, components: the --component values ([] when none), map: the value or null, judge: --judge given, out: the value or null, checks: the value, a key only when given}; no --deck → "missing --deck"; run without --processor → "missing --processor"; for run a --run-id not matching ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ → "--run-id must match ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+$ (got '<v>')"; numbers in the order --slice-cap-bytes (deck check), --deadline, --max-cards, --max-retry-batches (run): digits only, ≥ 1 ("<f> must be a positive integer (got '<v>')"), --max-retry-batches ≥ 0 ("must be a non-negative integer"). Every failure is {ok: false, error: {error: {code: 4, kind: "UsageError" | "NotYetError", message}}}. Defaults: root ".", pretty false, sliceCapBytes 500000, runId null, deadlineSeconds 2400, maxCards null (= the deck's card count), maxRetryBatches 2.

Steps:
- produces: Command

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given argv ["deck", "check", "--deck", "d.json"]; when parsed; then {ok: true, command: {name: "deck check", root: ".", pretty: false, deck: "d.json", sliceCapBytes: 500000}}
2. given argv ["--pretty", "run", "--deck", "d.json", "--processor", "s", "--root", "/r", "--run-id", "r1", "--deadline", "60", "--max-cards", "3", "--max-retry-batches", "0"]; when parsed; then {ok: true, command: {name: "run", root: "/r", pretty: true, deck: "d.json", processor: "s", runId: "r1", deadlineSeconds: 60, maxCards: 3, maxRetryBatches: 0}}
3. given argv ["frobnicate"]; when parsed; then {ok: false, error: {error: {code: 4, kind: "UsageError", message: "unknown command: frobnicate"}}}
4. given argv ["scout"], then ["deck", "status"]; when parsed; then NotYetError (code 4) "command scout is not available yet", then NotYetError "command deck status is not available yet"
5. given argv ["run", "--deck", "d.json"]; when parsed; then UsageError "missing --processor"
6. given argv ["deck", "check", "--deck", "d.json", "--processor", "s"]; when parsed; then UsageError "flag --processor does not apply to deck check"
7. given argv ["run", "--deck", "d", "--processor", "s", "--deadline", "0"]; when parsed; then UsageError "--deadline must be a positive integer (got '0')"
8. given argv ["--root"], then []; when parsed; then UsageError "flag --root needs a value", then UsageError "no command (commands: deck check, plan, run)"
9. given argv ["plan", "--spec", "c.yaml", "--component", "a", "--map", "m.json", "--component", "b", "--judge", "--out", "d.json", "--pretty"]; when parsed; then {ok: true, command: {name: "plan", root: ".", pretty: true, spec: "c.yaml", components: ["a", "b"], map: "m.json", judge: true, out: "d.json"}}
10. given argv ["plan", "--root", "/r", "--spec", "c.yaml"]; when parsed; then {ok: true, command: {name: "plan", root: "/r", pretty: false, spec: "c.yaml", components: [], map: null, judge: false, out: null}}
11. given argv ["plan", "--component", "a"]; then ["plan", "--spec", "c", "--judge", "--judge"]; then ["run", "--deck", "d", "--processor", "s", "--judge"]; when parsed; then UsageError "missing --spec"; then "flag --judge given twice"; then "flag --judge does not apply to run"
12. given argv ["plan", "--spec", "c.yaml", "--checks", "decks/p1/checks.json"]; when parsed; then {ok: true, command: {name: "plan", root: ".", pretty: false, spec: "c.yaml", components: [], map: null, judge: false, out: null, checks: "decks/p1/checks.json"}}
13. given argv ["run", "--deck", "d", "--processor", "s", "--checks", "x"]; ["plan", "--checks"]; ["plan", "--checks", "a", "--checks", "b"]; when parsed; then UsageError "flag --checks does not apply to run"; "flag --checks needs a value"; "flag --checks given twice"

Data Command: One parsed invocation.
Schema:
{ name: 'deck check', root, pretty, deck, sliceCapBytes } | { name: 'run', root, pretty, deck, processor, runId: string | null, deadlineSeconds, maxCards: number | null, maxRetryBatches } | { name: 'plan', root, pretty, spec, components: string[], map: string | null, judge: boolean, out: string | null, checks?: string }

## Component requirements / guardrails

Requirements:
- Strict TypeScript: tsconfig strict, ESM, no `any`; every module compiles with tsc --noEmit.
- One Document Out: Every command prints exactly one JSON document on stdout and nothing else; the human log goes to stderr.
- Deterministic Core: cards and compiler give byte-identical results for the same inputs: no clock, no randomness, no environment reads. acceptance is bound only in its pure parts (Snapshot Targets, Build Attempt Diff): Run Acceptance spawns a shell and its only timer is the child's timeout; env and the timeout are parameters, never process.env (06.10, P3). processor reads the environment only in Read Registry; Assemble Request, Read Response and Stub Answer are pure of clock and network; the transport and its sleep are parameters of Send Generation (P4). git spawns only in Run Git, synchronously, with the child's environment given whole as a parameter; it reads no process.env and no clock of its own (P6). cli touches the process only in its entry src/cli.ts: the environment, the working directory, the clock and the output streams reach main() as parameters, and the environment reaches the processor only through Read Registry (P7). language is pure data and pure functions: no clock, no environment, no file system, no child process; node:path is its only Node module; its shell lines are text (P8). contour reads no file, no clock and no environment: it parses the text it is given; the package yaml is imported in Parse Document alone (P9). planner reads no file, no clock and no environment: the cli reads the record and the map and passes which files exist as a function; node:path is its only Node module (P10a). builder reads no file, no clock and no environment: the caller passes the checks, the cards, the profile and the texts of the guard, the locator and the probes; node:path is its only Node module (P10b).
- Node Only: Runtime dependencies: Node 20 built-ins and the package `yaml` (the record reader), nothing else; dev dependencies pinned exactly, no ^ or ~.

Guardrails:
- No Network In Tests: tests/setup.ts makes fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and net.connect throw "network blocked in tests"; only the processor's own transport is mocked.
- No Shell Outside Acceptance: child processes are spawned only by Run Acceptance, the git module (in Run Git alone, P6) and the processor's none; everything else is pure.
- Frozen Tree During Run: while a run is in flight no file outside the cards' targets and .morph/ changes; a changed declared input discards the answer unread.

## Function Read Plan Checks

Files of `plan --checks`.

Behaviour: readPlanChecks(root, checksPath), in order, a failure {ok: false, result}: the file not regular under root → 4 UsageError "checks file not found: <checksPath>"; Parse Document(text, checksPath) error → 2 DeckError, it; Read Checks' problems → 2 DeckError "<checksPath> is not a valid checks document (<n> problem|problems):\n" + them joined by "\n"; GUARD_PATH "decks/tools/guard.mjs", LOCATOR_PATH "decks/tools/firstdiff.mjs" not regular → 4 UsageError "guard|locator file not found: <path>". Probes: per card, files null, <parts>/<id>.probe.ts if regular. → {ok: true, checks, texts: {guard, firstdiff, probes}}.

Steps:
- reads: Checks
- uses: contour
- uses: builder
- produces: Plan Checks

2. given that root; then no guard.mjs; then no firstdiff.mjs; when readPlanChecks(root, "nope.json"); then "decks/p1/checks.json" twice; then 4 UsageError "checks file not found: nope.json"; "guard file not found: decks/tools/guard.mjs"; "locator file not found: decks/tools/firstdiff.mjs"
3. given c.json = "{"; then {"cards": []}; when readPlanChecks(root, "c.json"); then 2 DeckError beginning "cannot parse c.json: "; then "c.json is not a valid checks document (2 problems):\nphase: required\ncards: must be a non-empty list"

{ version: 1, phase: string, parts: string, frozen: string[], fullExclude: string[], ownGit: boolean, cards: { id: string, smoke: number | null, extra: string | null, files: JudgeFile[] | null }[] }

Data Plan Checks: Result.
Schema:
{ ok: true, checks: Checks, texts: BuildTexts } | { ok: false, result: Command Result }

## Function Plan Command

`morph plan --spec`: the record and the map read under the root, cut by Plan Spec, the deck written to --out; one Plan Document.

Behaviour: planCommand(root, args), in this order. The spec file path.resolve(root, args.spec) not a regular file → code 4 UsageError "spec file not found: <spec as given>"; a map given and not a regular file → code 4 UsageError "map file not found: <map as given>". Load Spec: loadContour(the spec's UTF-8 text, args.spec), then loadMap(the map's text, args.map) when a map is given (none → the empty map {version: 1, package: null, language: null, docs: [], groups: [], cards: [], extraCards: []}); an error → code 2 DeckError with that error as the message. Plan Spec({record, map, spec: args.spec, components: args.components, judge: args.judge, hasFile: a path is a regular file under root}); an error → code 2 DeckError with it. When args.out is not null the cards are written to path.resolve(root, args.out) as JSON.stringify(cards, null, 2) + "\n", parent directories created; that file is a deck `morph run --deck` and `morph deck check` read. With args.checks, before the write: Read Plan Checks (a failure is the result); Build Acceptances({cards, checks, profile: resolveProfile(null, map.language), texts}), errors → 2 DeckError "acceptances not built (<n> error|errors):\n" + them joined by "\n"; its cards replace the plan's, but a card the map gives an acceptance (map card by customId ?? id, extra card by customId) stays. → {code: 0, document: {spec, components, cards, generations, externalDependsOn, out: args.out}}. Nothing else is written; nothing is written on an error.

Steps:
- uses: contour
- uses: planner
- calls: Read Plan Checks
- uses: builder
- produces: Plan Document

Examples (the tests must prove each one):
1. given a tmp root holding ledger.yaml and ledger.map.json (the planner fixtures' texts) and a tests/helpers.ts; args spec "ledger.yaml", components ["ledger", "store"], map "ledger.map.json", judge true, out "decks/p.json"; when planCommand; then code 0; document equal to ledger.plan.json plus out "decks/p.json"; the file decks/p.json is exactly JSON.stringify(document.cards, null, 2) + "\n"; Read Deck File of it is ok with 17 cards and externalDependsOn ["outside"] (ref: tests/fixtures/planner/ledger.yaml, tests/fixtures/planner/ledger.map.json, tests/fixtures/planner/ledger.plan.json)
2. given the same root; spec "nope.yaml"; then spec "ledger.yaml" with map "m.json"; when planCommand; then {code: 4, document: {error: {code: 4, kind: "UsageError", message: "spec file not found: nope.yaml"}}}; then the same with "map file not found: m.json"
3. given bad.yaml = "System: {}\n" as the spec; then spec ledger.yaml with m.json = "{\"docs\": \"x\"}" as the map; when planCommand; then code 2 DeckError "bad.yaml is not a valid record (3 problems):\nSystem.name: required\nSystem.description: required\nSystem.groups: required"; then code 2 DeckError "m.json is not a valid map (1 problem):\ndocs: must be a list"
4. given the same root, components ["nope"], out "decks/q.json"; when planCommand; then code 2 DeckError "no Component 'nope' in the record (have: ledger, store)"; decks/q.json not written
5. given main(["plan", "--root", <the root>, "--spec", "ledger.yaml", "--component", "store", "--map", "ledger.map.json"]) in process, deps {env: {}, now: () => 0, cwd: "/", transport: null}; when main; then 0; one stdout chunk, a document with components ["store"], 4 cards, out null; stderr ["morph plan: exit 0\n"]; nothing written under the root
6. given example 1 plus checks decks/l1/checks.json, decks/tools/guard.mjs "// guard\n", firstdiff.mjs "// firstdiff\n", decks/l1/parts/parse.probe.ts, ledger-types.probe.ts "// probe\n"; when planCommand; then code 0; example 1 but parse's acceptance codeAcceptance(ctx {phase "l1", siblings ["src/ledger/types.ts"]}, "// probe\n", null, null), parse-judge's judgeAcceptance(ctx, files); ledger-types keeps the map's "exit 0\n" (ref: tests/fixtures/cli/l1.checks.json)
7. given example 6, checks decks/l2/checks.json = {"phase": "l2", "cards": [{"id": "zz"}]}; when planCommand; then 2 DeckError "acceptances not built (1 error):\nchecks card 'zz' is not in the deck"
8. given the repository; contour.yaml, planner, cli, judge, map tests/fixtures/cli/p10.map.json, checks decks/p10/checks.json; when planCommand; then code 0; v2deck.json's 12 acceptances byte for byte, guard.p10.txt (trimEnd) replaced by decks/tools/guard.mjs (ref: decks/p10/v2deck.json, tests/fixtures/builder/guard.p10.txt)

Data Plan Document: stdout of plan; the Plan of the planner plus the deck file written.
Schema:
{ spec: string, components: string[], cards: Card[], generations: string[][], externalDependsOn: Record<string, string[]>, out: string | null }

Data Plan Document: stdout of plan; the Plan of the planner plus the deck file written.
Schema:
{ spec: string, components: string[], cards: Card[], generations: string[][], externalDependsOn: Record<string, string[]>, out: string | null }

Callee Read Plan Checks: Files of `plan --checks`.
Behaviour: readPlanChecks(root, checksPath), in order, a failure {ok: false, result}: the file not regular under root → 4 UsageError "checks file not found: <checksPath>"; Parse Document(text, checksPath) error → 2 DeckError, it; Read Checks' problems → 2 DeckError "<checksPath> is not a valid checks document (<n> problem|problems):\n" + them joined by "\n"; GUARD_PATH "decks/tools/guard.mjs", LOCATOR_PATH "decks/tools/firstdiff.mjs" not regular → 4 UsageError "guard|locator file not found: <path>". Probes: per card, files null, <parts>/<id>.probe.ts if regular. → {ok: true, checks, texts: {guard, firstdiff, probes}}.

Preconditions a test's setup depends on:
- planner · Cut Judges · Cut Component made the cuts; an extra card is a Cut Card with component and profile null, functions [] and slicedByMap true
